$comment: Documented exceptions for packages/admin-sdk/scripts/check-openapi-parity.mjs. Every entry needs a reason. allowedMissingPaths suppresses hard errors for SDK calls the API no longer documents (broken SDK routes awaiting removal); allowedMissingSchemas suppresses schema warnings; ignoredAdminPaths lists documented admin operations the SDK intentionally does not implement yet.

schemaAliases.reason: The inventory availability endpoint documents InventoryAvailability; the SDK names the same body AvailabilityResponse.
The transfer endpoint documents TransferResponse; the SDK names the same body InventoryTransferResponse.
The inquiry unread counter documents UnreadCountResponse; the SDK names the same body InquiryUnreadCountResponse.
The notification channel test result documents TestChannelResponse; the SDK names the same body NotificationChannelTestResponse.
The inquiry form field option documents FieldOption; the SDK names the same body InquiryFieldOption.
The inquiry form draft body documents SaveInquiryDraftRequest; the SDK names the same body SaveInquiryFormDraftRequest.
The batch settings body documents SettingsRequest; the SDK names the same body SettingsUpdateRequest.
The bulk price endpoint documents BulkPricesRequest; the SDK names the same body BulkPriceRequest.
The fail-session endpoint documents FailSessionRequest; the SDK names the same body FailPaymentSessionRequest.

ignoredAdminPaths.reason: The admin app manages campaigns with its own request helper (apps/admin/src/lib/campaigns.ts); the package SDK predates those routes and will gain methods with the SDK extraction.
Navigations are served to the admin app's content clients directly; SDK methods are a planned extraction.
Navigation items are served to the admin app's content clients directly; SDK methods are a planned extraction.
Redirects are served to the admin app's content clients directly; SDK methods are a planned extraction.
Customer groups are served to the admin app's own client (apps/admin/src/lib/customer-groups.ts); SDK methods are a planned extraction.
Bulk price reads and calculations are served through the admin app's pricing client; SDK methods are a planned extraction.
Fulfillment sets are served to the admin app's shipping client; SDK methods are a planned extraction.
Sales-channel assignment is a storefront-availability concern served by the admin app's catalog client.
The reindex trigger is an operational maintenance endpoint with no SDK caller.
The plugins pages call the API through apps/admin/src/lib/plugins.ts with multipart and observability reads; the stable, typed subset lives on client.plugins.
